description: Validates Dockerfile safety, structure, and spec compliance before producing a build artifact

rules.description: dockerfile-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare runtime, entrypoint, and ports
A Dockerfile must be present in the build context. Accepted names: Dockerfile, Dockerfile.prod, Dockerfile.production
The final Dockerfile stage must declare exactly one CMD or ENTRYPOINT instruction — duplicates are silently collapsed and make intent unreadable
Every FROM instruction must use a pinned version tag or SHA digest. Tags :latest, :dev, :main, :master, :edge and bare image names (no tag) are forbidden
The container must run as a non-root user. A USER instruction is required in the final stage and must not specify root or uid 0
ARG/ENV instructions must not embed secret-looking values. Detection: name matches password|secret|token|api_key|credentials AND value is non-placeholder (≥4 non-whitespace chars)
A .dockerignore file must exist at the build context root to prevent .git, node_modules, and .env files from entering the image layer
Every port in dockerfile-spec.json[ports] must have a corresponding EXPOSE instruction. Skipped when spec.ports is empty
rules.note: Conditional — skipped when spec.ports is empty or Dockerfile is absent

rules.description: dockerfile-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers — a spec with placeholders is not production-ready
Dockerfile must declare HEALTHCHECK (orchestrators detect stuck containers) and WORKDIR (prevents writes to /). Local file copies must use COPY not ADD (ADD silently unpacks archives)
forbidden: ADD (for local files — use COPY instead)
